text:
London gets much more rain than hot, dry cities such as Cairo (about 25 mm a year), Dubai and Riyadh (about 100 mm each), and Las Vegas (about 120 mm). Los Angeles (about 370 mm) and Madrid (about 440 mm) are also clearly drier than London's roughly 600 mm. These are approximate long-term averages that I haven't checked against a live source.

CONFIDENCE: 80
